title: Soleone Gaming
pitch: A personal release calendar for the games I'm watching: how hyped I am before launch, and a short scored review once I've played them.
description: Cover-led cards by month that keep uncertain dates honest, reviews with spoiler tags and their own URLs, and a local editor with a Pi research agent that sources dates and cover art.

externals.name: Research agent
externals.note: The hosted calendar is read-only: the editor and the Pi research agent only run on a local dev server.
